verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS email platform that holds customer and subscriber data, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment. The only privacy item is a generic claim about helping customers meet data security and privacy standards, which is a related topic, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
